newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT shareholders seek special meeting.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT shareholders seek special meeting.

text.p: Wyser-Pratte & Co Inc and Providence Capital Inc said on Tuesday that they are seeking a special shareholder meeting for COMSAT Corp to remove voting rights limits and to schedule the company's annual meeting as soon as possible.
COMSAT has restrictions on voting rights of shareholders who own more than five percent of the company's common stock, Wyser-Pratte and Providence said in a joint statement.
COMSAT was not immediately available for comment.
Wyser-Pratte and Providence criticized the current management's financial performance, despite "a number of prized assets" including the satellite business.
